pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high edge angularity and serrated pixel gradients. Patches on the lower neck and mid-flank exhibit star-like projections and variable spatial area, primarily dark brown against a lighter background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming complex junction nodes with 3 to 5 intersections. Corridor thickness is consistent on the lower flank but loses definition and pixel contrast as it approaches the upper dorsal region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark mane exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette. The profile is intermittently obscured by small, dark, perched avian figures (oxpeckers) which disrupt the continuity of the 1D contour.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Significant area of textural disruption and de-pigmentation on the mid-upper flank. The region shows a grayish, scaly, and thickened skin texture where the standard patch/corridor pattern is largely obliterated.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several thin, linear, diagonal scars or scratch marks are visible cutting across the pelage pattern on the mid-section of the flank, appearing as lighter-colored textural breaks.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple oxpeckers (Buphagus) are visible perched along the dorsal ridge and mane area, causing localized visual occlusions of the giraffe's silhouette.
